security.twoFaSubtitle: Protect your account with a TOTP authenticator app.
security.recManager: As a platform manager, enabling 2FA is strongly recommended to protect cross-tenant access.

security.step1Body: Open Google Authenticator, Authy, or any TOTP app.
security.step2Body: Tap Add account, then choose Enter setup key and paste the key below, or tap Scan QR code and use the link on your phone.
security.step3Body: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app to confirm.
